## Vesta 1.1.8

### Changes

- Updated Bunny Hop, Edge Jump and automatic grenade throw to use configurable game keys rather than reading the game's changing bind table.
- Improved overlay frame pacing and stability, including the CPU/GPU rendering choice.
- Improved aim movement, ESP timing, radar placement and kill-effect rendering.
- Updated Seed Trigger timing and shot calculations. Accuracy still depends on live game and server conditions; perfect hit registration is not guaranteed.
- Removed Crosshair Sync after the game's crosshair changes. Other crosshair options remain available.

### Detection notice

Current reports indicate that VACnet / VAC Live can detect Aimbot, RCS and Triggerbot use and issue cooldowns. No FPS setting, play style or feature configuration guarantees protection. Vesta makes no claim of immunity from cooldowns or bans.
